DSH 上下文管理与 token 优化节省插件。","id":"gh:1404374196","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-sieve","slug":"Sev7eEn7/dsh-sieve","topics":["agent-tools","ai-agent","ai-coding","coding-agent","context-engineering","context-management","context-pruning","context-window","cordis","deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","llm","llm-agent","llm-cost","prompt-compression","token-efficiency","token-optimization","tool-output","typescript"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-sieve: context engineering & token optimization plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) — tool output "},{"id":"p1s2","text":"filtering, context pruning, progressive skill disclosure. 36% smaller payload in offline replay. DSH"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" 上下文管理与 token 优化节省插件。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"sieve / dsh-sieve"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**Your agent navigates countless decisions across long loops, yet most tokens pay for dead logs and "},{"id":"p4s2","text":"stale history.
sieve is a precision mesh inside the execution loop: cutting through context inflatio"},{"id":"p4s3","text":"n and delivering only the critical context that decides the next step.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Context engineering, token efficiency and long-task supervision plugins for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"**−36%** request payload (offline replay, 100 trajectories) · **−21%** main model input tokens (live"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" model, 80 runs) · **~0.3 s** per judgment · **0** DSH core patches"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"How each number was measured, and what it does not show: offline replay · live model results. The li"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"ve runs predate the current Jev / Laya setup."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"A real session in DSH Web: while the agent reads code and runs tests, the Sieve page on the right co"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"unts up the estimated input token reduction and the characters taken out of the context."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"sieve is a high-performance DSH plugin that filters tool output, forgets stale context, and disclose"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s skills strictly on demand. Every raw output is archived before rewriting and remains one `read` aw"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ay. Powered by the same judge engine, a suite of harness modules supervises long tasks to eliminate "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"false completions and infinite loops."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> [!IMPORTANT]
> sieve needs a judge model: **Jev** (hosted, needs an API key) or **Laya** (local, m"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"acOS on Apple Silicon). It never borrows the session's own model. Without one, the token-saving deci"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"sions change nothing and the harness modules run on their rules alone. Set one up."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Why sieve"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Your agent navigates hundreds of critical decisions across complex tool-calling loops."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"Yet one glance at its real context ledger reveals a grim reality: actual user prompts and core code "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"represent only a tiny fraction of the payload. The overwhelming bulk is pure context inflation:"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- **The tool output tsunami**: A test runner spews 8,000 characters. The model only needs the single"},{"id":"p14s2","text":" failing assertion, yet repeatedly pays for 200+ lines of passing tests on every subsequent turn.
- "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"**Ghostly stale history**: A file read thirty steps ago—long since superseded—rides along as a ghost"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" passenger in every request.
- **Bloated skill catalogs**: Hundreds of skill descriptions loaded at "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"session start when 97% are never touched, permanently diluting the model's attention."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"This is not pocket change—it is a critical signal-to-noise crisis."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"Input tokens snowball quadratically with every turn. As the context window chokes on dead logs, the "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"model's attention dilutes, hallucinations increase, and tasks stall out."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**sieve is the precision mesh built for this storm.**"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"No blunt truncations. Zero patches to DSH core. Before tool results enter the session and before his"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"tory piles into dead weight, sieve queries a lightweight judge model (~0.3 s) to prune the noise, ar"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"chive the byte-exact original to disk, and hand the model only lean, high-signal context."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### What it looks like"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"A 263-line vitest run with one failure (8,020 characters), through sieve's test-log rules:"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The model receives 1,138 characters instead of 8,020 (**an 86% reduction**)."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"- **Byte-exact preservation**: Kept lines match the original byte for byte; failure traces, diffs, a"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"nd test summaries are strictly protected.
- **Zero data loss**: The full output is archived to spill"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" disk first—one `read` away if the agent ever needs it.
- **Cache-friendly by design**: Pruning happ"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ens before the result enters the session, so prompt cache prefixes never see the bloated version."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"### Why a dedicated judge model"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- **The limit of static heuristics**: Regex and rule-based scripts choke on unfamiliar formats, forc"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ing them to let bloated logs through untouched.
- **The cost of asking the main model**: Having the "},{"id":"p25s3","text":"primary LLM decide what to discard wastes expensive tokens and burns an entire reasoning turn on rou"},{"id":"p25s4","text":"ecide what to discard wastes expensive tokens and burns an entire reasoning turn on routine cleanup."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"**sieve's approach: a dedicated sidecar judge.**
It poses lightweight, structured yes/no or single-c"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"hoice questions with calibrated probabilities in **~0.3 seconds** (median, offline replay).
If confi"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"dence falls below threshold—or if any error or timeout occurs—sieve triggers safe fallback: **the fu"},{"id":"p26s4","text":"ll original is kept untouched**."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"## Core capabilities and use cases"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"For AI coding agents on DeepSeek Harness, especially with verbose test logs, frequent tool calls, lo"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"ng sessions or large skill catalogs."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| Area | How sieve handles it |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| **Input token reduction** | Filters redundant tool content before it enters the session, reducing "},{"id":"p30s2","text":"input resent on later steps |
| **Tool output filtering** | Handles build logs, test reports and com"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"mand output by category, protecting failure details and test summaries |
| **Context compaction / pr"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"uning** | Replaces irrelevant older tool results in batches, retaining archive pointers for on-deman"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"d retrieval |
| **Progressive skill disclosure** | Shows skills by task relevance, reducing context "},{"id":"p30s6","text":"window usage from unrelated descriptions |
| **Prompt cache awareness** | Processes new results befo"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"re they are recorded and batches historical pruning to control prefix rebuild frequency |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## What's new in 0.4.0: harness modules"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"> [!NOTE]
> **Released in 0.4.0**; 0.4.1 is the same plugin and also loads on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 and lat"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"er. Coming from 0.3.0, which has only the token-saving decisions? Run `dsh plugin --profile web add "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"dsh-sieve@0.4.1 dsh-sieve-web@0.4.1` and restart `dsh web`; see Upgrade and uninstall."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"Saving tokens was only the opening act. For deep, long-horizon tasks, sieve introduces six harness m"},{"id":"p33s2","text":"odules driven by the exact same judge engine to prevent drift, loops, and false completions:"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Module | In one line |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| **Hive** | Ask one question, get 2–6 read-only bees on it. They post findings to a shared board, a"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"nd the judge decides which bee needs which finding |
[该节后续省略]"}],"truncated":true}
